scripts.purpose: Runs on a server and creates a gzip-compressed tar archive of the server's own directories into $HOME/Sync/Nextcloud/Backup/Remote. Settings are hardcoded in the script; it does not load a config file or contact other hosts. install.sh deploys this script to each host in REMOTE_SERVERS and does not run it remotely. Expected outcome after a successful run: an archive matching sorkhackmac12-remote-backup-<YYYYmmddHHMMSS>.tar.gz exists in that backup directory. Open questions: help text advertises --wait-for-dbus while the parser accepts --wait-for-notification-daemon; remote/config is planned for deployment by install.sh but this script does not source any config file.

arguments.name: -h|--help
arguments.description: Print usage and the option list, then exit 0.

arguments.name: --dry-run
arguments.description: Skip archive creation and verification; report the archive path that would be produced.

arguments.name: --wait-for-notification-daemon
arguments.description: Wait in 60-second intervals until dunst, mako, xfce4-notifyd, or notification-daemon is running.

arguments.name: --notify-send
arguments.description: Send a desktop notification after completion; exits 1 when no notification daemon is running.

environment.name: HOME
environment.description: Base for the hardcoded backup directory, source directories, and exclusion strings.

exit_codes.meaning: Help printed, dry-run completed, or archive created and verified; a notification is sent when requested.
Unknown option, a source directory missing, archive creation or verification failed, or no notification daemon running with --notify-send.
